apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata: {name: harbor-stateful}
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector: {app: harbor-stateful}
  ports: [{name: app, port: 8080, targetPort: 8080}]
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata: {name: harbor-stateful}
spec:
  serviceName: harbor-stateful
  replicas: 2
  selector: {matchLabels: {app: harbor-stateful}}
  template:
    metadata: {labels: {app: harbor-stateful}}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: harbor-stateful:lab
          imagePullPolicy: Never
          volumeMounts: [{name: data, mountPath: /data}]
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata: {name: data}
      spec:
        accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
        resources: {requests: {storage: 1Gi}}
